component.name: Periphera
component.summary: Discover and control OpenRazer peripherals on Linux

description.p: An independent Linux controller with a charcoal and green interface for OpenRazer-supported peripherals and the Razer Barracuda X Chroma headset.

ul.li: Headset battery, equalizer, microphone monitoring and six-zone lighting
Home-page scanning with peripheral categories and individual connected devices in the sidebar
All devices reported by the host OpenRazer daemon, including Naga Trinity
Capability-driven lighting, DPI, polling, power, scroll and macro controls
Custom LED colours using the connected device's multi-row matrix layout
Read-only mouse and mouse-mat previews for exploring without hardware
Explicit Apply actions and device response diagnostics

description.p: OpenRazer integration is experimental and needs physical owner testing. Install OpenRazer's driver and desktop-session daemon on the host. Controls and connection support depend on that installed driver and device. The direct Barracuda X Chroma backend needs a host udev permission rule.
This is not an official Razer application or a complete Synapse replacement.
Discover all OpenRazer devices, group the sidebar by peripheral type, and show controls from each device's live capabilities.
Use the transparent Venom kraken artwork for the application icon, window icon and sidebar branding.
Add eight Razer RGB mouse mats with effects, custom colours and hardware-free previews.
Add experimental Naga V2 Pro controls and Flatpak packaging.
